name: Finish one story repair-loop attempt
content:
Complete the assigned story in `{{project.spoke_root}}`. Follow `{{project.hub_root}}/AGENTS.md`, applicable spoke rules, and `{{project.hub_root}}/.agents/skills/work/SKILL.md` for implementation, S.E.E. updates, evidence and completion.

Fetch the current story and milestone. Continue from existing code and saved evidence; if already Done with supported, checked criteria, return complete. Preserve the story goal, criterion wording and dependencies.

Finish the remaining work and focused checks. The workflow's final quality task owns the normal repository gate; run any checks explicitly required by this story. The workflow also owns retry waits.

Before returning incomplete, save what changed, observed results, and the next concrete action in the story notes.

Final response: one JSON object:
{"story_id":"assigned id","result":"complete|retry|blocked","remaining_criteria":[{"index":1,"reason":"unfinished requirement"}],"blocker_kind":null,"blocker":null}

Use complete only after saved Done/all-checked readback; remaining_criteria must then be empty. Use retry when the attempt budget ends with work remaining. Use blocked only for an actual human-only requirement or unresolvable external obstruction; set blocker_kind to human_review or external and give the specific obstruction. Missing implementation is remaining work.
